description: Climate Resilience Evaluation and Awareness Tool (CREAT) Climate Scenarios Projection Map is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by EPA Creating Resilient Water Utilities Program. Water utility managers can use this map to understand how climate change may affect their ability to maintain and deliver adequate, reliable, and sustainable water supplies. This multi-tabbed map is part of the Climate Resilience Evaluation and Awareness Tool for water sector utilities. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Erosion and Shoreline Recession, Extreme Heat, Flooding – Coastal, Flooding – Rainfall-induced, High Winds, Severe Winter Weather, Water Quality. Assets: Energy and Utilities, Water Infrastructure – Drinking Water, Water Infrastructure – General, Water Infrastructure – Stormwater, Water Infrastructure – Wastewater. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
